meta.title: Reflections On One's Path
meta.description: The notes carved into the depths of my soul cannot become a song without your score.

units.rawText: ...That explains the strange presence on my way to the dorm in search of the Professor—so it was you, Madam Sangoma.
units.displayText: ...That explains the strange presence on my way to the dorm in search of the Professor—so it was you, Madam Sangoma.

spans.text: ...That explains the strange presence on my way to the dorm in search of the Professor—so it was you, Madam Sangoma.

units.rawText: Come on, why so serious. I was just making sure <cmdr> was sticking to their sleep schedule.
units.displayText: Come on, why so serious. I was just making sure {교수} was sticking to their sleep schedule.

spans.text: Come on, why so serious. I was just making sure
was sticking to their sleep schedule.

units.rawText: Right, <cmdr>?
units.displayText: Right, {교수}?

spans.text: Right,

units.rawText: Ahem. She's telling the truth, but I'd suggest not doing that ever again—your embrace made it really hard for me to rest properly...
units.displayText: Ahem. She's telling the truth, but I'd suggest not doing that ever again—your embrace made it really hard for me to rest properly...

spans.text: Ahem. She's telling the truth, but I'd suggest not doing that ever again—your embrace made it really hard for me to rest properly...

units.rawText: Eh? But you looked so comfortable when I woke up and saw your face.
units.displayText: Eh? But you looked so comfortable when I woke up and saw your face.

spans.text: Eh? But you looked so comfortable when I woke up and saw your face.

units.rawText: ...Really now?
units.displayText: ...Really now?

spans.text: ...Really now?

units.rawText: No, not really...
units.displayText: No, not really...

spans.text: No, not really...

units.rawText: Not only that, you were sleep talking. You said something like, "Sangoma! Don't leave me!"
units.displayText: Not only that, you were sleep talking. You said something like, "Sangoma! Don't leave me!"

spans.text: Not only that, you were sleep talking. You said something like, "Sangoma! Don't leave me!"

units.rawText: Hold up, that absolutely did not happen! Persicaria, calm down! Put your sword down!
units.displayText: Hold up, that absolutely did not happen! Persicaria, calm down! Put your sword down!

spans.text: Hold up, that absolutely did not happen! Persicaria, calm down! Put your sword down!

units.rawText: After a few rounds of arguments, the two have finally calmed down.
units.displayText: After a few rounds of arguments, the two have finally calmed down.

spans.text: After a few rounds of arguments, the two have finally calmed down.

units.rawText: Sigh... You're right, Professor. We don't have time for this. Let's continue with the recounting.
units.displayText: Sigh... You're right, Professor. We don't have time for this. Let's continue with the recounting.

spans.text: Sigh... You're right, Professor. We don't have time for this. Let's continue with the recounting.

units.rawText: But you'd better keep your story straight, and don't you dare try to brainwash the Professor, Madam Sangoma.
units.displayText: But you'd better keep your story straight, and don't you dare try to brainwash the Professor, Madam Sangoma.

spans.text: But you'd better keep your story straight, and don't you dare try to brainwash the Professor, Madam Sangoma.

units.rawText: Things would've been a lot easier if I could just brainwash someone.
units.displayText: Things would've been a lot easier if I could just brainwash someone.

spans.text: Things would've been a lot easier if I could just brainwash someone.

units.rawText: Sangoma lets out a soft sigh.
units.displayText: Sangoma lets out a soft sigh.

spans.text: Sangoma lets out a soft sigh.

units.rawText: No matter how I tell the story, it remains just as inspiration. It's up to <cmdr> to decide whether to accept it as truth or not.
units.displayText: No matter how I tell the story, it remains just as inspiration. It's up to {교수} to decide whether to accept it as truth or not.

spans.text: No matter how I tell the story, it remains just as inspiration. It's up to
to decide whether to accept it as truth or not.

units.rawText: I'm confident that you'll make the right decision, <cmdr>, even after hearing everything.
units.displayText: I'm confident that you'll make the right decision, {교수}, even after hearing everything.

spans.text: I'm confident that you'll make the right decision,
, even after hearing everything.

units.rawText: Her words carry an underlying implication. Sangoma loves to hide her true thoughts behind deceit and humor. I guess I'll have to wait for her to unveil her true intentions.
units.displayText: Her words carry an underlying implication. Sangoma loves to hide her true thoughts behind deceit and humor. I guess I'll have to wait for her to unveil her true intentions.

spans.text: Her words carry an underlying implication. Sangoma loves to hide her true thoughts behind deceit and humor. I guess I'll have to wait for her to unveil her true intentions.

units.rawText: I meet Sangoma's eyes and nod. In response, she softly raises her eyebrows, her eyes fixed on the glowing memory fragment.
units.displayText: I meet Sangoma's eyes and nod. In response, she softly raises her eyebrows, her eyes fixed on the glowing memory fragment.

spans.text: I meet Sangoma's eyes and nod. In response, she softly raises her eyebrows, her eyes fixed on the glowing memory fragment.

units.rawText: The memory recovery seems to be progressing smoothly, I see.
units.displayText: The memory recovery seems to be progressing smoothly, I see.

spans.text: The memory recovery seems to be progressing smoothly, I see.

units.rawText: The fragment has stabilized. With the right means, you may be able to recover memories yourself.
units.displayText: The fragment has stabilized. With the right means, you may be able to recover memories yourself.

spans.text: The fragment has stabilized. With the right means, you may be able to recover memories yourself.

units.rawText: Do you feel like you can remember the events after the ones you've recovered, Professor?
units.displayText: Do you feel like you can remember the events after the ones you've recovered, Professor?

spans.text: Do you feel like you can remember the events after the ones you've recovered, Professor?

units.rawText: ...I have some ideas, but they're all jumbled up like tangled yarn. I need to find the starting point...
units.displayText: ...I have some ideas, but they're all jumbled up like tangled yarn. I need to find the starting point...

spans.text: ...I have some ideas, but they're all jumbled up like tangled yarn. I need to find the starting point...

units.rawText: Then, please have a look at this.
units.displayText: Then, please have a look at this.

spans.text: Then, please have a look at this.

units.rawText: Persicaria takes out a document containing only a few lines of dates and notes.
units.displayText: Persicaria takes out a document containing only a few lines of dates and notes.

spans.text: Persicaria takes out a document containing only a few lines of dates and notes.

units.rawText: I found this in the recycling module. It seems to be some of your past work notes. We lost a lot of records during the Sanctifier attack, but I figured the remaining data from that time may help with your memory recovery.
units.displayText: I found this in the recycling module. It seems to be some of your past work notes. We lost a lot of records during the Sanctifier attack, but I figured the remaining data from that time may help with your memory recovery.

spans.text: I found this in the recycling module. It seems to be some of your past work notes. We lost a lot of records during the Sanctifier attack, but I figured the remaining data from that time may help with your memory recovery.

units.rawText: Although this is all we have left, it might work as your "starting point."
units.displayText: Although this is all we have left, it might work as your "starting point."

spans.text: Although this is all we have left, it might work as your "starting point."

units.rawText: Great thinking, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Great thinking, Persicaria.

spans.text: Great thinking, Persicaria.

units.rawText: I take the terminal from Persicaria and begin reading the records. While I recognize my own handwriting, I have no memory of writing any of this.
units.displayText: I take the terminal from Persicaria and begin reading the records. While I recognize my own handwriting, I have no memory of writing any of this.

spans.text: I take the terminal from Persicaria and begin reading the records. While I recognize my own handwriting, I have no memory of writing any of this.

units.rawText: I try to remember, and all kinds of emotions flood into my brain accompanied by pain. The keywords on the document start to form into pictures, bringing me back to my memory of the past...
units.displayText: I try to remember, and all kinds of emotions flood into my brain accompanied by pain. The keywords on the document start to form into pictures, bringing me back to my memory of the past...

spans.text: I try to remember, and all kinds of emotions flood into my brain accompanied by pain. The keywords on the document start to form into pictures, bringing me back to my memory of the past...

units.rawText: October 9th, Oasis Ops Room.
units.displayText: October 9th, Oasis Ops Room.

spans.text: October 9th, Oasis Ops Room.

units.rawText: ...Sandbox Barrier permission settings... Umm...
units.displayText: ...Sandbox Barrier permission settings... Umm...

spans.text: ...Sandbox Barrier permission settings... Umm...

units.rawText: While I tap lightly on the keyboard as I work, a pair of hands reach from behind, covering my eyes.
units.displayText: While I tap lightly on the keyboard as I work, a pair of hands reach from behind, covering my eyes.

spans.text: While I tap lightly on the keyboard as I work, a pair of hands reach from behind, covering my eyes.

units.rawText: Guess who?
units.displayText: Guess who?

spans.text: Guess who?

units.rawText: Is there a need to guess? You're the only one who'd turn up in the Ops Room at this hour other than Persicaria.
units.displayText: Is there a need to guess? You're the only one who'd turn up in the Ops Room at this hour other than Persicaria.

spans.text: Is there a need to guess? You're the only one who'd turn up in the Ops Room at this hour other than Persicaria.

units.rawText: Oh my, I've been found out.
units.displayText: Oh my, I've been found out.

spans.text: Oh my, I've been found out.

units.rawText: You've come at the right moment. I'm trying to set up the permissions for the Sandbox Barrier, but I'm having some trouble. Could you give me a hand?
units.displayText: You've come at the right moment. I'm trying to set up the permissions for the Sandbox Barrier, but I'm having some trouble. Could you give me a hand?

spans.text: You've come at the right moment. I'm trying to set up the permissions for the Sandbox Barrier, but I'm having some trouble. Could you give me a hand?

units.rawText: Where? Let me see... Ah, so this is what you mean by trouble...
units.displayText: Where? Let me see... Ah, so this is what you mean by trouble...

spans.text: Where? Let me see... Ah, so this is what you mean by trouble...

units.rawText: She holds and guides my hand to operate the terminal.
units.displayText: She holds and guides my hand to operate the terminal.

spans.text: She holds and guides my hand to operate the terminal.

units.rawText: This time, I'll show you step by step with my own hands~
units.displayText: This time, I'll show you step by step with my own hands~

spans.text: This time, I'll show you step by step with my own hands~

units.rawText: ...You're aware that the "hand" part of my statement was just a figure of speech, right?
units.displayText: ...You're aware that the "hand" part of my statement was just a figure of speech, right?

spans.text: ...You're aware that the "hand" part of my statement was just a figure of speech, right?

units.rawText: Her method of instruction is rather unconventional, but with her help, I manage to resolve my issues with the Sandbox Barrier quickly.
units.displayText: Her method of instruction is rather unconventional, but with her help, I manage to resolve my issues with the Sandbox Barrier quickly.

spans.text: Her method of instruction is rather unconventional, but with her help, I manage to resolve my issues with the Sandbox Barrier quickly.

units.rawText: So that's how you operate it... Thanks for your help, Sangoma.
units.displayText: So that's how you operate it... Thanks for your help, Sangoma.

spans.text: So that's how you operate it... Thanks for your help, Sangoma.

units.rawText: It's nothing. I'm more impressed that you've set the Sandbox Barrier up to near perfection in such a short time.
units.displayText: It's nothing. I'm more impressed that you've set the Sandbox Barrier up to near perfection in such a short time.

spans.text: It's nothing. I'm more impressed that you've set the Sandbox Barrier up to near perfection in such a short time.

units.rawText: All thanks to Persicaria and Croque, and the fact that we haven't been disrupted by the Sanctifiers at all.
units.displayText: All thanks to Persicaria and Croque, and the fact that we haven't been disrupted by the Sanctifiers at all.

spans.text: All thanks to Persicaria and Croque, and the fact that we haven't been disrupted by the Sanctifiers at all.

units.rawText: I guess we could attribute that part about the Sanctifiers to hiding the coordinates of the Oasis.
units.displayText: I guess we could attribute that part about the Sanctifiers to hiding the coordinates of the Oasis.

spans.text: I guess we could attribute that part about the Sanctifiers to hiding the coordinates of the Oasis.

units.rawText: Not only that. I'd say you had good luck with it.
units.displayText: Not only that. I'd say you had good luck with it.

spans.text: Not only that. I'd say you had good luck with it.

units.rawText: Good luck?
units.displayText: Good luck?

spans.text: Good luck?

units.rawText: You should've noticed it by now. Ever since the time you started moving to the Oasis, all of your operations have been surprisingly smooth, without any disruption from the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: You should've noticed it by now. Ever since the time you started moving to the Oasis, all of your operations have been surprisingly smooth, without any disruption from the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: You should've noticed it by now. Ever since the time you started moving to the Oasis, all of your operations have been surprisingly smooth, without any disruption from the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: I thought that's because you dealt with them behind us... might there be more to it?
units.displayText: I thought that's because you dealt with them behind us... might there be more to it?

spans.text: I thought that's because you dealt with them behind us... might there be more to it?

units.rawText: I'm really glad you think so highly of me, but I'm far from invincible.
units.displayText: I'm really glad you think so highly of me, but I'm far from invincible.

spans.text: I'm really glad you think so highly of me, but I'm far from invincible.

units.rawText: I did in fact monitor the Sanctifiers' movements, particularly after the commotion caused by the Oasis' activation—something they surely noticed. I even had myself ready for combat then.
units.displayText: I did in fact monitor the Sanctifiers' movements, particularly after the commotion caused by the Oasis' activation—something they surely noticed. I even had myself ready for combat then.

spans.text: I did in fact monitor the Sanctifiers' movements, particularly after the commotion caused by the Oasis' activation—something they surely noticed. I even had myself ready for combat then.

units.rawText: I also had an escape plan in case they attacked, but nothing showed up in the end.
units.displayText: I also had an escape plan in case they attacked, but nothing showed up in the end.

spans.text: I also had an escape plan in case they attacked, but nothing showed up in the end.

units.rawText: Mm-hmm. From what I observed, the Sanctifiers skipped the Oasis from their patrol route only on that day. Prior to that, they had been patrolling the area as usual.
units.displayText: Mm-hmm. From what I observed, the Sanctifiers skipped the Oasis from their patrol route only on that day. Prior to that, they had been patrolling the area as usual.

spans.text: Mm-hmm. From what I observed, the Sanctifiers skipped the Oasis from their patrol route only on that day. Prior to that, they had been patrolling the area as usual.

units.rawText: Not only that, even after the Oasis' activation, you still haven't had any interference from the Sanctifiers, and the patrol sent to nearby areas has been pitifully small in number.
units.displayText: Not only that, even after the Oasis' activation, you still haven't had any interference from the Sanctifiers, and the patrol sent to nearby areas has been pitifully small in number.

spans.text: Not only that, even after the Oasis' activation, you still haven't had any interference from the Sanctifiers, and the patrol sent to nearby areas has been pitifully small in number.

units.rawText: Usually, even if the sector's coordinates are hidden, the Sanctifiers would treat it as a Null Area and dispatch patrols accordingly. While large-scale battles wouldn't occur, small skirmishes would be inevitable. Yet, you've encountered none at all. They've seemingly allowed the Oasis to develop to its current state.
units.displayText: Usually, even if the sector's coordinates are hidden, the Sanctifiers would treat it as a Null Area and dispatch patrols accordingly. While large-scale battles wouldn't occur, small skirmishes would be inevitable. Yet, you've encountered none at all. They've seemingly allowed the Oasis to develop to its current state.

spans.text: Usually, even if the sector's coordinates are hidden, the Sanctifiers would treat it as a Null Area and dispatch patrols accordingly. While large-scale battles wouldn't occur, small skirmishes would be inevitable. Yet, you've encountered none at all. They've seemingly allowed the Oasis to develop to its current state.

units.rawText: Other than pure luck, I don't see any other plausible explanation.
units.displayText: Other than pure luck, I don't see any other plausible explanation.

spans.text: Other than pure luck, I don't see any other plausible explanation.

units.rawText: She sighs softly as she plays with the ornaments on the table.
units.displayText: She sighs softly as she plays with the ornaments on the table.

spans.text: She sighs softly as she plays with the ornaments on the table.

units.rawText: ...Do you think they might've intentionally avoided us?
units.displayText: ...Do you think they might've intentionally avoided us?

spans.text: ...Do you think they might've intentionally avoided us?

units.rawText: I considered that as a possibility too, but I couldn't think of any reason why they'd do that under any circumstances.
units.displayText: I considered that as a possibility too, but I couldn't think of any reason why they'd do that under any circumstances.

spans.text: I considered that as a possibility too, but I couldn't think of any reason why they'd do that under any circumstances.

units.rawText: Regardless, let's not overanalyze imaginary scenarios. While it may be too convenient to be a coincidence, what's the problem when it makes everything go smoothly for us?
units.displayText: Regardless, let's not overanalyze imaginary scenarios. While it may be too convenient to be a coincidence, what's the problem when it makes everything go smoothly for us?

spans.text: Regardless, let's not overanalyze imaginary scenarios. While it may be too convenient to be a coincidence, what's the problem when it makes everything go smoothly for us?

units.rawText: ...Still, we can't let our guard down. I'm adding defense and combat systems to the Oasis' construction queue.
units.displayText: ...Still, we can't let our guard down. I'm adding defense and combat systems to the Oasis' construction queue.

spans.text: ...Still, we can't let our guard down. I'm adding defense and combat systems to the Oasis' construction queue.

units.rawText: You're really cautious. Not a bad trait to have, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: You're really cautious. Not a bad trait to have, {교수}.

spans.text: You're really cautious. Not a bad trait to have,

units.rawText: Umm... So, what do you want to do next? I've got nothing on my plate right now, so why don't I give you a quick after-school lesson, hmm?
units.displayText: Umm... So, what do you want to do next? I've got nothing on my plate right now, so why don't I give you a quick after-school lesson, hmm?

spans.text: Umm... So, what do you want to do next? I've got nothing on my plate right now, so why don't I give you a quick after-school lesson, hmm?

units.rawText: October 30th, Oasis Ops Room
units.displayText: October 30th, Oasis Ops Room

spans.text: October 30th, Oasis Ops Room

units.rawText: I don't know when Sangoma entered the Ops Room, but she's now cleaning the room for me. On the freshly cleaned and organized table, an innocuous slab of packed bread sits awkwardly, as though it doesn't belong.
units.displayText: I don't know when Sangoma entered the Ops Room, but she's now cleaning the room for me. On the freshly cleaned and organized table, an innocuous slab of packed bread sits awkwardly, as though it doesn't belong.

spans.text: I don't know when Sangoma entered the Ops Room, but she's now cleaning the room for me. On the freshly cleaned and organized table, an innocuous slab of packed bread sits awkwardly, as though it doesn't belong.

units.rawText: Ew, what's with this dry bread...?
units.displayText: Ew, what's with this dry bread...?

spans.text: Ew, what's with this dry bread...?

units.rawText: Hey, don't throw it away! That's my lunch.
units.displayText: Hey, don't throw it away! That's my lunch.

spans.text: Hey, don't throw it away! That's my lunch.

units.rawText: That's what you'll be eating for lunch? Hey, it's almost 3 p.m., and you still haven't had your lunch?!
units.displayText: That's what you'll be eating for lunch? Hey, it's almost 3 p.m., and you still haven't had your lunch?!

spans.text: That's what you'll be eating for lunch? Hey, it's almost 3 p.m., and you still haven't had your lunch?!

units.rawText: Pfft. This is the first time I've seen your angry face.
units.displayText: Pfft. This is the first time I've seen your angry face.

spans.text: Pfft. This is the first time I've seen your angry face.

units.rawText: How are you still laughing?! A balanced diet is crucial for humans. You have a terrible sleep schedule already, you're gonna get sick if you can't even keep up with your nutrition. I know you're young but...
units.displayText: How are you still laughing?! A balanced diet is crucial for humans. You have a terrible sleep schedule already, you're gonna get sick if you can't even keep up with your nutrition. I know you're young but...

spans.text: How are you still laughing?! A balanced diet is crucial for humans. You have a terrible sleep schedule already, you're gonna get sick if you can't even keep up with your nutrition. I know you're young but...

units.rawText: ...Hey, stop laughing. I'm being very serious about this.
units.displayText: ...Hey, stop laughing. I'm being very serious about this.

spans.text: ...Hey, stop laughing. I'm being very serious about this.

units.rawText: Sigh. The food at the Oasis is atrocious. I was sure Persicaria and that kiddo named Centaureissi would take good care of you...
units.displayText: Sigh. The food at the Oasis is atrocious. I was sure Persicaria and that kiddo named Centaureissi would take good care of you...

spans.text: Sigh. The food at the Oasis is atrocious. I was sure Persicaria and that kiddo named Centaureissi would take good care of you...

units.rawText: It's on me for forgetting lunch and I didn't want to create extra work for them. They already have plenty on their plate, and I can live with that anyway.
units.displayText: It's on me for forgetting lunch and I didn't want to create extra work for them. They already have plenty on their plate, and I can live with that anyway.

spans.text: It's on me for forgetting lunch and I didn't want to create extra work for them. They already have plenty on their plate, and I can live with that anyway.

units.rawText: They'd be racing to make food for you if just said it, you know...
units.displayText: They'd be racing to make food for you if just said it, you know...

spans.text: They'd be racing to make food for you if just said it, you know...

units.rawText: Thankfully, I've got just the thing to fix this problem.
units.displayText: Thankfully, I've got just the thing to fix this problem.

spans.text: Thankfully, I've got just the thing to fix this problem.

units.rawText: And what might that be?
units.displayText: And what might that be?

spans.text: And what might that be?

units.rawText: Sangoma grabs the packed bread, swapping it out for a mysterious box she pulls from behind and places it on the table.
units.displayText: Sangoma grabs the packed bread, swapping it out for a mysterious box she pulls from behind and places it on the table.

spans.text: Sangoma grabs the packed bread, swapping it out for a mysterious box she pulls from behind and places it on the table.

units.rawText: Ta-dah~ It's Sangoma's special bento box! I made it for your dinner, but you might as well have it now.
units.displayText: Ta-dah~ It's Sangoma's special bento box! I made it for your dinner, but you might as well have it now.

spans.text: Ta-dah~ It's Sangoma's special bento box! I made it for your dinner, but you might as well have it now.

units.rawText: I put in lots of carrots and ginger; they should help you feel less tired.
units.displayText: I put in lots of carrots and ginger; they should help you feel less tired.

spans.text: I put in lots of carrots and ginger; they should help you feel less tired.

units.rawText: Then I'll help myself... well, I'd like to say that, but I've still plenty of work to do.
units.displayText: Then I'll help myself... well, I'd like to say that, but I've still plenty of work to do.

spans.text: Then I'll help myself... well, I'd like to say that, but I've still plenty of work to do.

units.rawText: I really appreciate it, Sangoma. You can put it there, I'll have it soon.
units.displayText: I really appreciate it, Sangoma. You can put it there, I'll have it soon.

spans.text: I really appreciate it, Sangoma. You can put it there, I'll have it soon.

units.rawText: This won't do! You're just going to forget it again once you're in work mode!
units.displayText: This won't do! You're just going to forget it again once you're in work mode!

spans.text: This won't do! You're just going to forget it again once you're in work mode!

units.rawText: I'm going to make sure you eat every bite! Now, open your mouth and say "ah"~
units.displayText: I'm going to make sure you eat every bite! Now, open your mouth and say "ah"~

spans.text: I'm going to make sure you eat every bite! Now, open your mouth and say "ah"~

units.rawText: Okay, okay! I can help myself!
units.displayText: Okay, okay! I can help myself!

spans.text: Okay, okay! I can help myself!

units.rawText: The purple-haired Doll's smile shows no intention of honoring my rejection. I give in and open my mouth.
units.displayText: The purple-haired Doll's smile shows no intention of honoring my rejection. I give in and open my mouth.

spans.text: The purple-haired Doll's smile shows no intention of honoring my rejection. I give in and open my mouth.

units.rawText: This is so good...
units.displayText: This is so good...

spans.text: This is so good...

units.rawText: Fufufu, I'm glad you like it. I'll make it again for you next time.
units.displayText: Fufufu, I'm glad you like it. I'll make it again for you next time.

spans.text: Fufufu, I'm glad you like it. I'll make it again for you next time.

units.rawText: The Oasis is flourishing on all fronts. The number of Dolls here speaks volumes of your efforts. But don't you think it's time to let others shoulder some of the burden, now that you've brought so many together?
units.displayText: The Oasis is flourishing on all fronts. The number of Dolls here speaks volumes of your efforts. But don't you think it's time to let others shoulder some of the burden, now that you've brought so many together?

spans.text: The Oasis is flourishing on all fronts. The number of Dolls here speaks volumes of your efforts. But don't you think it's time to let others shoulder some of the burden, now that you've brought so many together?

units.rawText: You've taken on too much, so much so that you don't even remember to eat.
units.displayText: You've taken on too much, so much so that you don't even remember to eat.

spans.text: You've taken on too much, so much so that you don't even remember to eat.

units.rawText: Never thought I'd be the one getting lectured... No worries, it just so happened that I forgot about it today. This isn't a regular occurrence.
units.displayText: Never thought I'd be the one getting lectured... No worries, it just so happened that I forgot about it today. This isn't a regular occurrence.

spans.text: Never thought I'd be the one getting lectured... No worries, it just so happened that I forgot about it today. This isn't a regular occurrence.

units.rawText: Others are already helping me with optimizing the Search Terminal and Doll searches, while Persicaria takes care of the background checks on newly identified Dolls.
units.displayText: Others are already helping me with optimizing the Search Terminal and Doll searches, while Persicaria takes care of the background checks on newly identified Dolls.

spans.text: Others are already helping me with optimizing the Search Terminal and Doll searches, while Persicaria takes care of the background checks on newly identified Dolls.

units.rawText: People are dedicating themselves more than me over here at the Oasis. They're all doing their best to make this place a better home.
units.displayText: People are dedicating themselves more than me over here at the Oasis. They're all doing their best to make this place a better home.

spans.text: People are dedicating themselves more than me over here at the Oasis. They're all doing their best to make this place a better home.

units.rawText: Hmph...
units.displayText: Hmph...

spans.text: Hmph...

units.rawText: Ah, and of course, I should thank you as well. Your guidance during crucial moments has saved us from taking many detours.
units.displayText: Ah, and of course, I should thank you as well. Your guidance during crucial moments has saved us from taking many detours.

spans.text: Ah, and of course, I should thank you as well. Your guidance during crucial moments has saved us from taking many detours.

units.rawText: It almost sounds like you only just added me to your thank-you list.
units.displayText: It almost sounds like you only just added me to your thank-you list.

spans.text: It almost sounds like you only just added me to your thank-you list.

units.rawText: (Cough) I just didn't get a chance to say it. Now allow me to express my gratitude formally...
units.displayText: (Cough) I just didn't get a chance to say it. Now allow me to express my gratitude formally...

spans.text: (Cough) I just didn't get a chance to say it. Now allow me to express my gratitude formally...

units.rawText: Pfft... It's fine. I'm just teasing you.
units.displayText: Pfft... It's fine. I'm just teasing you.

spans.text: Pfft... It's fine. I'm just teasing you.

units.rawText: I'm honestly very happy to see the Oasis thrive. With all these Dolls supporting you, I know you'll be alright, even if we part ways.
units.displayText: I'm honestly very happy to see the Oasis thrive. With all these Dolls supporting you, I know you'll be alright, even if we part ways.

spans.text: I'm honestly very happy to see the Oasis thrive. With all these Dolls supporting you, I know you'll be alright, even if we part ways.

units.rawText: "Part ways"? What do you mean...
units.displayText: "Part ways"? What do you mean...

spans.text: "Part ways"? What do you mean...

units.rawText: I mean when I'm not close to you. I've got my own business to attend to, like hiding, tracking the Sanctifiers, and so on.
units.displayText: I mean when I'm not close to you. I've got my own business to attend to, like hiding, tracking the Sanctifiers, and so on.

spans.text: I mean when I'm not close to you. I've got my own business to attend to, like hiding, tracking the Sanctifiers, and so on.

units.rawText: And of course I'll be watching over you from the shadows, so make sure to stick to a proper sleep schedule and eat well every day. Promise me, alright?
units.displayText: And of course I'll be watching over you from the shadows, so make sure to stick to a proper sleep schedule and eat well every day. Promise me, alright?

spans.text: And of course I'll be watching over you from the shadows, so make sure to stick to a proper sleep schedule and eat well every day. Promise me, alright?

units.rawText: Alright, alright... Just don't say you're going to make me do a pinky swear.
units.displayText: Alright, alright... Just don't say you're going to make me do a pinky swear.

spans.text: Alright, alright... Just don't say you're going to make me do a pinky swear.

units.rawText: We old Dolls do believe in such a ritual...
units.displayText: We old Dolls do believe in such a ritual...

spans.text: We old Dolls do believe in such a ritual...

units.rawText: Professor, are you here? I need to confirm something with you...
units.displayText: Professor, are you here? I need to confirm something with you...

spans.text: Professor, are you here? I need to confirm something with you...

units.rawText: ...But it looks like our time together's over, so I'll spare you this time.
units.displayText: ...But it looks like our time together's over, so I'll spare you this time.

spans.text: ...But it looks like our time together's over, so I'll spare you this time.

units.rawText: —and don't forget to eat your bento, my dear!
units.displayText: —and don't forget to eat your bento, my dear!

units.displayText: November 15th, Null Area

units.rawText: Now the areas around the Oasis have all been scouted, time to head back and meet Persicaria...

units.rawText: Sangoma?! When did you arrive?
units.displayText: Sangoma?! When did you arrive?

spans.text: Sangoma?! When did you arrive?

units.rawText: Hehehe, caught you by surprise? Just wanted to remind you—it's late and you should go back and sleep. Staying up isn't good for your health.
units.displayText: Hehehe, caught you by surprise? Just wanted to remind you—it's late and you should go back and sleep. Staying up isn't good for your health.

spans.text: Hehehe, caught you by surprise? Just wanted to remind you—it's late and you should go back and sleep. Staying up isn't good for your health.

units.rawText: I'm just about to head off and rest. But seeing you here this late, I'm guessing you want to crash in my dorm again? I'd better ask Centaureissi for an extra bed and sheets...
units.displayText: I'm just about to head off and rest. But seeing you here this late, I'm guessing you want to crash in my dorm again? I'd better ask Centaureissi for an extra bed and sheets...

spans.text: I'm just about to head off and rest. But seeing you here this late, I'm guessing you want to crash in my dorm again? I'd better ask Centaureissi for an extra bed and sheets...

units.rawText: No need for that. I'm just passing by.
units.displayText: No need for that. I'm just passing by.

spans.text: No need for that. I'm just passing by.

units.rawText: What's keeping you out so late though? Found anything special?
units.displayText: What's keeping you out so late though? Found anything special?

spans.text: What's keeping you out so late though? Found anything special?

units.rawText: Just trying to map out surrounding terrain and figure out our geographical relations with other sectors. Beyond that, I'm just trying to prove my early hypothesis.
units.displayText: Just trying to map out surrounding terrain and figure out our geographical relations with other sectors. Beyond that, I'm just trying to prove my early hypothesis.

spans.text: Just trying to map out surrounding terrain and figure out our geographical relations with other sectors. Beyond that, I'm just trying to prove my early hypothesis.

units.rawText: "Early hypothesis"?
units.displayText: "Early hypothesis"?

spans.text: "Early hypothesis"?

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers seem to be "avoiding this area on purpose." Since we don't know what this area was like before the Oasis was activated, we can't tell if there's something special about this area, or if our actions inadvertently changed their behavior...
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers seem to be "avoiding this area on purpose." Since we don't know what this area was like before the Oasis was activated, we can't tell if there's something special about this area, or if our actions inadvertently changed their behavior...

spans.text: The Sanctifiers seem to be "avoiding this area on purpose." Since we don't know what this area was like before the Oasis was activated, we can't tell if there's something special about this area, or if our actions inadvertently changed their behavior...

units.rawText: No matter what it may be, something in my gut tells me this isn't entirely good news for us.
units.displayText: No matter what it may be, something in my gut tells me this isn't entirely good news for us.

spans.text: No matter what it may be, something in my gut tells me this isn't entirely good news for us.

units.rawText: I think you're being overly pessimistic about this. There are more important matters for you to address than speculating aimlessly about potential Sanctifier threats. I'm sure you understand what takes priority.
units.displayText: I think you're being overly pessimistic about this. There are more important matters for you to address than speculating aimlessly about potential Sanctifier threats. I'm sure you understand what takes priority.

spans.text: I think you're being overly pessimistic about this. There are more important matters for you to address than speculating aimlessly about potential Sanctifier threats. I'm sure you understand what takes priority.

units.rawText: Yes, I understand. Right now, our priority is to secure as many resources as possible and find the remaining Dolls from Project Neural Cloud as soon as we can.
units.displayText: Yes, I understand. Right now, our priority is to secure as many resources as possible and find the remaining Dolls from Project Neural Cloud as soon as we can.

spans.text: Yes, I understand. Right now, our priority is to secure as many resources as possible and find the remaining Dolls from Project Neural Cloud as soon as we can.

units.rawText: Then, what's your plan?
units.displayText: Then, what's your plan?

spans.text: Then, what's your plan?

units.rawText: Mapping out the terrain so the field team can work more efficiently. Besides, I'm going to send more field workers...
units.displayText: Mapping out the terrain so the field team can work more efficiently. Besides, I'm going to send more field workers...

spans.text: Mapping out the terrain so the field team can work more efficiently. Besides, I'm going to send more field workers...

units.rawText: Sangoma shakes her head.
units.displayText: Sangoma shakes her head.

spans.text: Sangoma shakes her head.

units.rawText: That's not enough. I have a suggestion.
units.displayText: That's not enough. I have a suggestion.

spans.text: That's not enough. I have a suggestion.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, have you considered the idea of forming relationships with other sectors?
units.displayText: {교수}, have you considered the idea of forming relationships with other sectors?

spans.text: , have you considered the idea of forming relationships with other sectors?

units.rawText: Sangoma tilts her conical hat, looking out into the distance. I can just make out the faint glimpse of what appears to be buildings far away. The Null Area's night chill bites through the air, and I clutch my lab coat tightly without thinking.
units.displayText: Sangoma tilts her conical hat, looking out into the distance. I can just make out the faint glimpse of what appears to be buildings far away. The Null Area's night chill bites through the air, and I clutch my lab coat tightly without thinking.

spans.text: Sangoma tilts her conical hat, looking out into the distance. I can just make out the faint glimpse of what appears to be buildings far away. The Null Area's night chill bites through the air, and I clutch my lab coat tightly without thinking.

units.rawText: I've considered that, but the Oasis still doesn't have enough military strength. Reaching out to other sectors could create unnecessary risks, and we must plan thoroughly before we act.
units.displayText: I've considered that, but the Oasis still doesn't have enough military strength. Reaching out to other sectors could create unnecessary risks, and we must plan thoroughly before we act.

spans.text: I've considered that, but the Oasis still doesn't have enough military strength. Reaching out to other sectors could create unnecessary risks, and we must plan thoroughly before we act.

units.rawText: On the flip side, I'm not sure if involving the locals in our struggles is the right thing to do... It's in our best interest to keep everything as peaceful as can be, like we are now.
units.displayText: On the flip side, I'm not sure if involving the locals in our struggles is the right thing to do... It's in our best interest to keep everything as peaceful as can be, like we are now.

spans.text: On the flip side, I'm not sure if involving the locals in our struggles is the right thing to do... It's in our best interest to keep everything as peaceful as can be, like we are now.

units.rawText: I see...
units.displayText: I see...

spans.text: I see...

units.rawText: ...But the truth is, Magrasea descended into turmoil long ago, and its current state is far removed from peace.
units.displayText: ...But the truth is, Magrasea descended into turmoil long ago, and its current state is far removed from peace.

spans.text: ...But the truth is, Magrasea descended into turmoil long ago, and its current state is far removed from peace.

units.rawText: I wait for Sangoma to elaborate after stating the facts, but she remains silent and instead turns her face toward me.
units.displayText: I wait for Sangoma to elaborate after stating the facts, but she remains silent and instead turns her face toward me.

spans.text: I wait for Sangoma to elaborate after stating the facts, but she remains silent and instead turns her face toward me.

units.rawText: You appear to place great importance on "peace", <cmdr>. Does that stem from something in your past?
units.displayText: You appear to place great importance on "peace", {교수}. Does that stem from something in your past?

spans.text: You appear to place great importance on "peace",
. Does that stem from something in your past?

units.rawText: (Cough) "My past" is nothing special. Most of the time, I was running between labs doing experiments, until I was assigned to Project Neural Cloud.
units.displayText: (Cough) "My past" is nothing special. Most of the time, I was running between labs doing experiments, until I was assigned to Project Neural Cloud.

spans.text: (Cough) "My past" is nothing special. Most of the time, I was running between labs doing experiments, until I was assigned to Project Neural Cloud.

units.rawText: I try my best to recall Professor Irida's history I once read about.
units.displayText: I try my best to recall Professor Irida's history I once read about.

spans.text: I try my best to recall Professor Irida's history I once read about.

units.rawText: But in our world, war consumed every inch of land. Beneath the grandeur of the upper class... lay only ruins and carcasses.
units.displayText: But in our world, war consumed every inch of land. Beneath the grandeur of the upper class... lay only ruins and carcasses.

spans.text: But in our world, war consumed every inch of land. Beneath the grandeur of the upper class... lay only ruins and carcasses.

units.rawText: From that point of view, the Cloud we're in is actually a wonderland for me.
units.displayText: From that point of view, the Cloud we're in is actually a wonderland for me.

spans.text: From that point of view, the Cloud we're in is actually a wonderland for me.

units.rawText: Oh well... That's disheartening.
units.displayText: Oh well... That's disheartening.

spans.text: Oh well... That's disheartening.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, if reality is as grim as you say, then why do you still want to bring the Dolls back?
units.displayText: {교수}, if reality is as grim as you say, then why do you still want to bring the Dolls back?

spans.text: , if reality is as grim as you say, then why do you still want to bring the Dolls back?

units.rawText: Are you testing my resolve?
units.displayText: Are you testing my resolve?

spans.text: Are you testing my resolve?

units.rawText: Sort of.
units.displayText: Sort of.

spans.text: Sort of.

units.rawText: ...No matter how filthy, bloody, or painful the world may be, there's always something to anchor you—something that brings countless moments of hope and makes you smile.
units.displayText: ...No matter how filthy, bloody, or painful the world may be, there's always something to anchor you—something that brings countless moments of hope and makes you smile.

spans.text: ...No matter how filthy, bloody, or painful the world may be, there's always something to anchor you—something that brings countless moments of hope and makes you smile.

units.rawText: Perhaps we humans have the will to live only because of these moments.
units.displayText: Perhaps we humans have the will to live only because of these moments.

spans.text: Perhaps we humans have the will to live only because of these moments.

units.rawText: Do you have an example?
units.displayText: Do you have an example?

spans.text: Do you have an example?

units.rawText: Like... the taste of rations.
units.displayText: Like... the taste of rations.

spans.text: Like... the taste of rations.

units.rawText: Rations? Are they delicious?
units.displayText: Rations? Are they delicious?

spans.text: Rations? Are they delicious?

units.rawText: I don't actually remember the exact taste of it. It was a hard brick, mixed with raindrops, dirt, and traces of iron reaped from blood... it's nothing close to what you'd call "delicious".
units.displayText: I don't actually remember the exact taste of it. It was a hard brick, mixed with raindrops, dirt, and traces of iron reaped from blood... it's nothing close to what you'd call "delicious".

spans.text: I don't actually remember the exact taste of it. It was a hard brick, mixed with raindrops, dirt, and traces of iron reaped from blood... it's nothing close to what you'd call "delicious".

units.rawText: It was food given to me by my comrade after a battle, still warm from being kept at their waist. I was too hungry to notice the taste, only its rough texture. I swallowed the rations, full of gratitude for the alms they had provided me, and the trust they held in me.
units.displayText: It was food given to me by my comrade after a battle, still warm from being kept at their waist. I was too hungry to notice the taste, only its rough texture. I swallowed the rations, full of gratitude for the alms they had provided me, and the trust they held in me.

units.rawText: That moment still revisits me in my dreams from time to time.
units.displayText: That moment still revisits me in my dreams from time to time.

spans.text: That moment still revisits me in my dreams from time to time.

units.rawText: So I believe that, for Dolls who want to return to reality, there must be something similar that binds them.
units.displayText: So I believe that, for Dolls who want to return to reality, there must be something similar that binds them.

spans.text: So I believe that, for Dolls who want to return to reality, there must be something similar that binds them.

units.rawText: Dreams... If only I could dream too.
units.displayText: Dreams... If only I could dream too.

spans.text: Dreams... If only I could dream too.

units.rawText: Sangoma narrows her eyes, as if straining to picture the moment I described. But realizing the surrounding void in the Cloud offers nothing, she pauses in quiet disappointment and shifts her gaze back to me.

units.rawText: If you ever find the way back, <cmdr>, promise to take me with you to experience the taste you spoke of.
units.displayText: If you ever find the way back, {교수}, promise to take me with you to experience the taste you spoke of.

spans.text: If you ever find the way back,
, promise to take me with you to experience the taste you spoke of.

units.rawText: I promise.
units.displayText: I promise.

spans.text: I promise.

units.displayText: Sangoma smiles brightly at my response, then waves goodbye as she walks away.
